author: wlivesay
body:
#### PR description:
Adds two unit tests with the intention of seamlessly integrating L1 Tracking Git CI with Central CMSSW so PRs can be transferred one at a time as opposed to in bulk.

**`L1TKRunTest.sh`** runs L1 Tracking algorithms (Hybrid, Hybrid NewKF, Hybrid Displaced) in parallel via `L1TrackNtupleMaker_cfg.py`. Event and thread count can be set via BuildFile.xml. Expected to run 10 events for each PR and 1000 events for IB runs and upon request from L1TK on specific L1TK-related PRs. Then runs `makeHists.csh` and passes if compilation, running, and plotting stages are completed without errors and non-empty results.out files. However, this test would pass even if performance is poor or if plots are empty.

Copies of the cfg file and macro are made under $CMSSW_BASE/unit_tests to avoid writing under /src which isn't allowed for IB runs. The datasets currently use a different geometry than set in the code, but the difference doesn't apply to L1 Tracking.

**`L1TKComparisonTest.py`** compares 13 tracking metrics (efficiencies, TP and track multiplicities, fake and duplicate rates, z0 resolution) against an IB reference and against a long-term baseline stored in the script, and fails if any metric is worse than its allowed limit. The tolerances are placeholders (2% vs IB, 5% vs baseline) and should be updated with an error-based calculation. Comparison is hard-coded to only accept 1000+ events, so ensure saved results.out files are not from 10-event runs.

#### Notes for IB/CI integration:

BuildFile.xml is in a state that I expect every PR to run over. This serves as a simple check for compilation, dataset access, and cmsRun. The comparison test is left in a comment to be enabled along with the heavy run test (-e 1000) for IB runs.

The location of the 3 files that should be saved after each IB run are the following:
- $CMSSW_BASE/unit_tests/L1TKRunTest/HYBRID/results.out
- $CMSSW_BASE/unit_tests/L1TKRunTest/HYBRID_NEWKF/results.out
- $CMSSW_BASE/unit_tests/L1TKRunTest/HYBRID_DISPLACED/results.out

These 3 files should be saved by the IB side at a location of their choice. The only change required would be the BuildFile.xml -i input location for L1TKComparisonTest.py, pointing to that location.

The datasets should be copied from DAS to a location in Central CMSSW and accessed that way in the future to avoid requiring a grid proxy.

#### PR validation:

Light test (scram b runtests_L1TKRunTest, 10 events per algorithm) passes in CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5 under 5 minutes.
Heavy configuration (1000 events per algorithm, both tests) run on HTCondor: all three algorithms complete, and all 78 comparison checks pass. Repeated 1000-event runs give identical results.
scram b code-checks and scram b code-format report no changes (the PR contains no C++ code).
